original.value: A cinematic anime-style illustration of a quiet rural Japanese train station in early summer, filled with travel nostalgia and bright midday light. In the foreground, one high school girl stands alone on the platform near the left side of the frame, facing slightly toward the viewer with a shy, gentle posture, her legs together and one foot angled inward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} short bobbed hair with soft bangs, and wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: a white long-sleeved sailor blouse with navy trim, a vivid red neckerchief, a dark navy pleated skirt, white socks, and dark brown loafers. She holds a dark school bag in one hand at her side. Her expression should feel calm, a little wistful, as if she was just about to speak before the train arrived. Place her beside an old weathered wooden station building with large windowpanes and a simple wooden bench. Above her is 1 hanging station sign reading {argument name="station name" default="山ノ下駅"}, with smaller romanized text “YAMANOSHITA” and small local line information beneath it. The right half of the image opens to 1 set of railway tracks receding into the distance, bordered by lush green grass and wildflowers, with 1 small local train approaching from far down the line. Add a few utility poles running alongside the tracks. In the deep background, show a dramatic mountain range with lingering snow on the peaks under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. Composition should balance the girl on the left and the railway perspective on the right, with detailed background scenery, crisp sunlight, soft anime rendering, realistic textures in the station wood and rails, and a heartfelt slice-of-life travel mood.

zh-CN.value: 一幅充满旅行怀旧情怀和明亮午间阳光的宁静乡村日本火车站的动漫风格电影感插画，时值初夏。前景中，一名女高中生独自站在靠近画面左侧的站台上，身体略微朝向观众，姿态羞涩而温柔，双腿并拢，一只脚向内倾斜。她留有{argument name="hair color" default="black"}的齐耳短发，带有柔软的刘海，穿着经典的日本水手服校服：一件白色长袖水手领衬衫，配有海军蓝装饰，一条鲜红色的领巾，一条深蓝色百褶裙，白色袜子和深棕色乐福鞋。她一手提着深色的书包放在身侧。她的表情应该显得平静，略带惆怅，仿佛在火车到达前正准备说话。将她放在一座老旧饱经风霜的木质火车站站房旁边，站房有大窗户和一张简单的木制长椅。她的上方悬挂着一个写着{argument name="station name" default="山ノ下駅"}的车站标志，下方有较小的罗马字母文本"YAMANOSHITA"和小的本地线路信息。画面的右半部分延伸至一组伸向远方的铁轨，两侧是茂盛的绿草和野花，有一列小型本地火车从远处驶来。添加几根沿着轨道延伸的电线杆。在深远背景中，展示一座壮丽的山脉，山顶上仍有残留的积雪，天空是鲜明的蓝色，点缀着白色的云朵。构图应平衡左侧的女孩和右侧的铁路透视，包含详细的背景场景，明亮的阳光，柔和的动漫渲染，车站木材和铁轨的真实质感，以及充满真情实感的日常生活旅行氛围。
